description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Kumara Sarath Sumanasekera and Mr. Morris Wijerathne from the Administrative District of Colombo and Mr. A. A. Kuruppu Achchiralalage Kamal Nayana Kantha Kuruppu, Mr. Wijesinghe Arachchige Pradeep Chandana Perera and Mr. Dolton Janaka Suriya Bandarage Innocent Don from the Administrative District of Gampaha and Thebuwana Piyananda Thero from the Administrative District of Kalutara as the Members of the Western Province Provincial Council
